# Library

# Fig 5 prep

```{r fig5-prep}

MV_scores = read.table("MV_clustering.txt", sep = "\t", header = T)

MV_scores[,2:7] <- -1 * (MV_scores[,2:7])

# mutation_matrix = read.table("../data/Fig5_COLOSSUS_onco_matrix_CGGtier1and2_100genes.txt", sep = "\t", header = T)
# 
# mutation_matrix[mutation_matrix!=""] = 1
# mutation_matrix[mutation_matrix==""] = 0
# 
# colossus_id_conversion_table = read.table("../data/Fig5_colossus_88_ras_confirmed_from_wes_withID.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T)
# MV_scores$samples = str_replace_all(MV_scores$samples, "\\.", "-")
# 
# MV_scores_with_idconversion = merge(MV_scores, colossus_id_conversion_table, by.x="samples", by.y="COLOSSUS_ID")

MV2v6_scores = MV_scores[, c("samples", "MV5")]

MV2v6_scores$samples = str_replace_all(MV2v6_scores$samples, "\\.", "-")

MV2v6_clinical_all = read.table("Fig5_20200526-colossus_data_prognosis_calculated_Gift.txt", sep = "\t", header = T)
MV2v6_clinical_all = MV2v6_clinical_all[, c("COLOSSUS_ID", "perineural_invasion")]

rownames(MV2v6_clinical_all) = MV2v6_clinical_all$COLOSSUS_ID
MV2v6_clinical = MV2v6_clinical_all[MV2v6_scores$samples, ]

MV2v6_scores_clinical = merge(MV2v6_scores, MV2v6_clinical, by.x="samples", by.y="COLOSSUS_ID")

MV2v6_loadings = read.table("scaledLoadingsCoefficients.txt", sep = "\t", header = T)

MV2v6_loadings[,-1] <- -1 *(MV2v6_loadings[,-1])
MV2v6_loadings$Feature = rownames(MV2v6_loadings)
MV2v6_loadings = MV2v6_loadings[, c("Feature", "MV5")]

MV2v6_loadings = MV2v6_loadings[!is.na(MV2v6_loadings$MV5),]

MV2v6_phenotype = read.table("scaledRegressionCoefficients.txt", sep = "\t", header = T)
MV2v6_phenotype$clinical_category = rownames(MV2v6_phenotype)

MV2v6_phenotype[,-7] <- -1 *(MV2v6_phenotype[,-7])

```

```{r}
# corrected version Anguraj
MV2v6_loadings_labels$Feature_label <- gsub("_\\d+.*", "", MV2v6_loadings_labels$Feature)
MV2v6_loadings_labels$Feature_unique <- make.unique(MV2v6_loadings_labels$Feature_label)

MV2v6_loadings_labels <- MV2v6_loadings_labels[order(MV2v6_loadings_labels$MV5), ]

MV2v6_loadings_labels$Feature_unique <- factor(
  MV2v6_loadings_labels$Feature_unique,
  levels = MV2v6_loadings_labels$Feature_unique
)
MV2v6_loadings_labels$Feature_label <- gsub("_\\d+.*", "", MV2v6_loadings_labels$Feature)
MV2v6_loadings_labels$Feature_label <- gsub(
  "^X2\\.\\.\\.2S\\.4aR\\.8aS\\.\\.2\\.Hydroxy\\.4a\\.methyl\\.8\\.methylenedecahydro\\.2\\.naphthalenyl\\.acrylic_acid$",
  "HMMNA",
  MV2v6_loadings_labels$Feature_label
)

MV2v6_loadings_labels_long <- pivot_longer(
  MV2v6_loadings_labels,
  cols = c(MV5),
  names_to = "MV",
  values_to = "Loading"
)

p1 <- ggplot(MV2v6_loadings_labels_long,
             aes(x = Feature_unique, y = Loading)) +
  geom_col(fill = colour_wes_darjeeling1_n5[2]) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2), lty = 2, col = "#DD3333") +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(MV), scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = MV2v6_loadings_labels$Feature_label) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
  publication_theme

print(p1)

ggsave("5B_20260501_MV2_MV6_sig_known_metabolite_loading_bar_plot.pdf", p1, width = 5, height = 11)

```
